title: ScrapTown!
description: This Data Pack adds unique villages to your world with copper blocks in the basement and attic! alongside other landmarks, this Data Pack also includes "The Scrapper", a villager who will buy that precious copper off of you!
body:
This project adds procedural villages to your world containing copper blocks to steal and sell to "The Scrapper"

![Custom Villages with Copper to Steal!](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/cce2c44524abfd136b7c1dbe865da27c09f9a247.jpeg)


"The Scrapper" Spawns in his scrap trailer randomly throughout the overworld alongside other landmarks

![Look out for the scrappers Trailer!](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/83a5c158992a21765fff58ba1c7454c909130c04.jpeg)


P.S Keep an eye out in the Village for OGDukk! He has a 1 time trade for a special sword!
